description.value: The Hastings Branch is one of the Vancouver Public Library's neighbourhood branches, serving the East Hastings corridor in East Vancouver. As a public library, it offers free access to books, computers, and community programs to all visitors. Touring cyclists passing through the area may find it a useful rest stop in a busy urban neighbourhood.
